versions.content: Overlapping triggers and transmissions If PDID transmission is triggered according to [SWS_Dcm_01568] or [SWS_Dcm_01572] and the next pe- riodic transmission rate trigger occurs before the Dcm has finished sending the sched- uled PDIDs according to [SWS_Dcm_01570], the Dcm shall continue to transmit PDIDs according to [SWS_Dcm_01570] and schedule the PDIDs of the new trigger after the last previous PDID has been transmitted.
